ward.summary: Dahisar (ward R/N) used ₹35.3 lakh of its ₹48.0 lakh budget, or 74%, staying within budget across 82 jobs. About 27% of repairs were redone within 30 days, close to the expected 24%, and ₹11.6 lakh went on repairs that failed. The ward is flood-prone (flood index 0.65), which makes repairs harder to keep in place. Work finished on time 55% of the time, against 51% expected. One job is listed for review. Next, the ward should fund its 15 open issues, costing ₹5.7 lakh, starting with Western Express Highway. The remaining ₹12.7 lakh covers all of them.
